name: trstctl connector right-size entitlement mutation contract

request.body: tenant, connector, target, usage-backed remove_scopes, and recommended_scopes

effect.mutation: remove exactly the requested unused scopes
effect.response: mutation id, removed scopes, and rollback reference
effect.readback: GET of the same entitlement must return the effective recommended scopes

security.tenant_isolation: endpoint and token are selected by tenant plus connector
security.completion: passed only after authenticated mutation and independent effective-scope readback
